decisions.reason: As a 2023 multi-model spotlight line close to the core offer and still publicly backed after the initial launch year, it is likely to be retained because prior investment and visible commitment outweigh any unobserved short-term disappointment in a growing market.

As a 2023 ceiling luminaire line with its own page and clear fit to the firm's design-led, sustainable portfolio, management would usually continue to justify the earlier launch rather than withdraw it absent clear failure evidence.

Because this 2024 flexible spotlight line is very new, close to the established business, and prominently presented, disappointing early results could easily be framed as temporary, favoring continuation.

This 2024 ceiling canopy builds directly on the firm's modular lighting systems and has been visibly introduced, so sunk development and portfolio-complementarity make withdrawal within a year unlikely.
Although somewhat more niche, this 2024 low-voltage canopy extends the existing system logic and has its own page, which supports escalation of commitment and argues for keeping it on the market.

Despite weaker public commitment because it was only mentioned on the website, this 2024 multi-model track luminaire line remains close to the core assortment, so management would still be more likely to persist than to drop it quickly.
